description: ReEDS: Historical electricity demand profiles is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kodi Obika, Wesley Cole (National Renewable Energy Laboratory). This record provides hourly state-level electricity demand profiles for the contiguous United States (U.S.) for 15 weather years (2007–2013 + 2016–2023), used in the Regional Energy Deployment System (ReEDS) model. Profiles for 2007–2013 use data from FERC Form 714 and ISO/RTO websites; profiles for 2016–2023 use data from EIA Form 930 and ISO/RTO websites. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
